title: Branch teller on F3 asks for desktop Outlook/Excel; usageLocation missing
narrative: Branch 014 requests a frontline (F3) license for a new teller plus the desktop Office apps used by the cash-reconciliation workbook. F3 has no desktop-app entitlement, so the request is blocked until the manager either accepts web/mobile apps or funds an E3 seat. The HR feed also left usageLocation empty, so group-based licensing would silently inherit the tenant country.

auditEvidence.source: TAP issuance deferred until license decision (synthetic)
